instruction: Install the productivity extensions listed in the document on your Desktop by going to the Chrome Web Store and adding each one to your browser.

expected: Speechify Text to Speech Voice Reader

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing all 5 Chrome extensions listed in the document: Zoom Chrome Extension, Speechify Text to Speech Voice Reader, React Developer Tools, Momentum, and Google Translate. The evaluator verifies all expected extensions are installed by checking Chrome preferences file. This is a straightforward paraphrase of the original task with the same extensions.
